LanguageData.Mugirl_ColonyStart.label: Mugirl Start
LanguageData.Mugirl_ColonyStart.description: Several Mugirls who were either slaves of a mega corporation or rescued by an anti-slavery organisation have arrived here. They hope to build their own lives in this new environment, pursuing freedom and dignity.
LanguageData.Mugirl_ColonyStart.scenario.description: Several Mugirls who were formerly slaves of a mega corporation or rescued by an anti-slavery organisation will begin their new lives as your starting colonists. Having cast off their past restraints, they are gradually establishing a colony belonging to the Mugirls.
LanguageData.Mugirl_ColonyStart.scenario.name: Mugirl Start
LanguageData.Mugirl_ColonyStart.scenario.summary: Several escaped slave Mugirls are beginning their new lives in your colony. They need your help to adapt to freedom and the new environment.
